# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Aug 30, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on August 30, 2026, focused heavily on strengthening the ElizaOS cloud infrastructure. Key achievements include the implementation of a durable backup admission system, improved billing and account deletion policies, and extensive hardening of CI/CD workflows and staging environment reliability.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

*   **Cloud Infrastructure & Backup Systems**
    *   Implemented a durable backup admission authority to manage agent backups, including schema foundations and work enrollment by durable shard ([#29662](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29662), [#29694](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29694)).
    *   Added bounded claimant/recovery authority to handle backup work without shard starvation ([#29781](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29781)).
    *   Hardened billing and account deletion policies to preserve cancellation receipts and ensure consistency during account removal ([#29651](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29651)).

*   **CI/CD, Testing, and Staging Reliability**
    *   Restored and stabilized critical CI/CD contracts, including HMR, runtime, and visual/OCR contracts ([#30071](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30071)).
    *   Introduced protected staging operators for re-reviewing Dedicated selection receipts and added latency certification workflows ([#30048](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30048), [#30044](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30044)).
    *   Improved staging selection bootstrap logic to provide neutral, identifier-free evidence and better error classification ([#30108](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30108), [#30100](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/30100)).

*   **Inference & Provider Security**
    *   Enforced unified account-standing checks across paid and generative provider dispatches to ensure fail-closed behavior ([#29984](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29984), [#29977](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29977)).
    *   Aligned plugin-pty and other modules with shared build dependencies to prevent runtime failures in isolated environments ([#29971](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/29971)).
